decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a low-cost accessory that is cheap to keep in the catalogue, and with no evidence after 2019 the option still has value at little carrying cost.

Featured on the home page in both years, this box trailer series appears to be a core line whose value has not been shown to fail, and it shares production with established trailers, so carrying it costs little.
The car transporter is a more specialized niche product with its own page, and its prospects remain uncertain, but it fits the firm's platform and the cost of keeping it is moderate.
Its home-page prominence suggests a central series, and low-bed trailers are standard demand in this market, so the option is likely being exercised rather than abandoned.
High covers are a staple add-on to the trailer range that cost little to keep alongside existing production, and the prominent display gives no signal of failure.
This second box trailer series overlaps with B, which raises some risk of consolidation, but its continued home-page prominence argues for keeping it while demand resolves.
